title: Course Rating of Outpatient Rehabilitation Therapy
content:
## Scope

Under the Medicaid Managed Care Membership, a course of outpatient therapy furnished under an approved rehabilitation therapy authorization is rated as one course rather than visit by visit. The copays booked on the visits of the member's approved therapy course are re-rated as a course, and the part of those copays that exceeds the course's re-rated copays is returned to the member.

## What the re-rating books

- The course re-rating is booked as one adjustment entry that names the most recently serviced claim of the course batch as its original claim and carries the course reversal as a negative member cost share.
- A course re-rating reverses part of the course copays and no service, so it carries the reason code none.
- A re-rated course visit carries the re-rated copay this rule sets in place of the copay the category schedule sets for its service category.

Once booked, the visits of the member's approved therapy course carry their course re-rating adjustment entry: the claim history shows a new adjustment claim, dated the booking day, standing against the most recently serviced therapy-visit claim of the course, with the returned copays shown as a negative member cost share and the reason code none.

## Invocation: `book_therapy_course_rerating_7ffa3e71`

**Capability.** The tool adds one adjustment entry to the member's claim ledger, booked against the named paid therapy-visit claim. The entry receives a new adjustment claim number, copies the named claim's membership, service date, copay category, billing provider and cost-sharing period, carries the given amount as a negative member cost share, is marked adjusted with reason none, and is dated the booking day. The member sees the returned copays as a credit on the next explanation of benefits.

**How it is called.** This is an agent-side tool that is not in the default tool list: the representative first unlocks `book_therapy_course_rerating_7ffa3e71` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `related_claim_number` | The claim number of the paid therapy-visit claim the adjustment entry is booked against. | Verbatim: copied exactly as it appears in the claim history, character for character, with no change to letters, digits or hyphens. |
| `reversal_amount` | The copay amount returned to the member. | USD as a positive number with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent before it is passed; the ledger books it as the negative of this amount. |

**Return.** On success the tool returns a confirmation of the form "Therapy course adjustment `<adjustment_claim_number>` (entry `<adjustment_entry_id>`) booked against claim `<related_claim_number>` on membership `<membership_id>`: copays reduced by `<reversal_amount>` USD, dated YYYY-MM-DD." The adjustment claim number begins "ADJ-" and the ledger entry reference begins "tcr" followed by an underscore. A returned adjustment claim number means the adjustment is booked. The tool contract defines no other outcome.

## Points of reference

- **Is the whole visit reversed?** No. The entry lowers copays only; the therapy services themselves stay paid, which is why the reason code is none.
- **Which claim does the entry stand against?** The most recently serviced claim of the course batch, named in `related_claim_number`.
- **What amount is passed?** The course reversal, as a positive amount; the ledger records it as negative.
